description: Aerial imagery (likely false-colour infrared) map illustrating a land cover classification unit. The image depicts a large industrial site, identifiable by its numerous grey-toned buildings and impervious surfaces, situated adjacent to a dark reddish-brown water body. The industrial site is specifically delineated by a prominent cyan polygon and labelled with the numerical code "1120", which corresponds to a detailed classification within the CORINE Land Cover (CLC) or CLC+ (next-generation land cover/land use) framework, typically representing an "Industrial or commercial unit". Surrounding the industrial area and water body are residential zones characterized by smaller buildings and reddish areas indicating vegetation. Faint green lines delineate additional land cover boundaries, potentially including road networks or other artificial areas. This image exemplifies how complex land use categories like industrial sites are identified and mapped within the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS).
